subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: Should repair work begin from the source-level evidence, or must an Apple owner first reproduce this exact multi-history tool-run sequence on current main?
rationale: Current main already contains overlapping history-generation and provisional-row safeguards, so maintainer intent is needed on the proof threshold before changing this high-churn state machine.

options.title: Require deterministic current-main replay
options.body: Reproduce the reported event ordering in the shared Apple replay harness or on an iOS simulator before selecting the failing invariant and authorizing a fix.

options.title: Authorize source-led repair
options.body: Treat the instrumented v2026.7.1 report as sufficient and implement the narrowest missing reconciliation guard with regression coverage and device proof before landing.

recommendation.title: Require deterministic current-main replay
recommendation.body: Reproduce the reported event ordering in the shared Apple replay harness or on an iOS simulator before selecting the failing invariant and authorizing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This is an iOS-specific proof threshold and the issue timeline routes the Apple app decision to this area contact.
